crossRefs.note: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t…
They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell…
I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
translations.bsb: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
translations.kjv: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
translations.asv: But Judah shall abide for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
